newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Bakrie says invests in Iridium system.
newsitem.headline: Bakrie says invests in Iridium system.

text.p: Bakrie Communications Corp, a unit of Indonesian conglomerate Bakrie & Brothers, said on Thursday that it had invested $100 million in the Iridium satellite communications system.

It said in a statement that the investment will enable its affiliated company Link Telecommunications to operate and deliver mobile satellite services in Australia, New Zealand and others regions in the south Pacific.
The services will be operated in collaboration with Nippon Iridium Corp of Japan, it said.
Bakrie acquired a 74 percent stake in Link from Bell South Australia in 1995.

Iridium, a consortium of 17 international companies led by Motorola Inc, will provide from the last quarter of 1998 global digital wireless communications services which will include mobile telephones, paging and basic data services via portable hand-held terminals.
